title: Ubiquiti airMAX PBE-M5-400 PowerBeam M5 400 with 25 dBi Dish 150+ Mbps Wireless Radio Link

items.h: 5GHz Wireless Bridge Long-Range PtP & PtMP Link

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Ubiquiti airMAX PowerBeam M5 400 (PBE-M5-400) is a powerful 5GHz outdoor CPE designed for long-range, high-throughput point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless links. With an integrated 25 dBi directional dish antenna, it delivers 150+ Mbps of real TCP/IP throughput using Ubiquiti’s reliable airMAX TDMA protocol.

The PBE-M5-400 features a compact design, improved beam directivity, and enhanced noise immunity, making it ideal for noisy environments. Perfect for ISPs, enterprise networks, and wireless CCTV backhaul, it ensures stable, high-quality connectivity over long distances.

Key Features:

  • Frequency Range: 5.1 – 5.9 GHz

  • Integrated 25 dBi high-gain dish antenna

  • Real TCP/IP throughput: 150+ Mbps

  • Range: Up to 20+ km (Line-of-Sight)

  • airMAX TDMA protocol for interference mitigation

  • Outdoor weatherproof enclosure (UV stabilized plastic)

  • Passive PoE (24V) support

  • Lightweight and easy-to-mount dish design

Link Distance:

  • Point-to-Point (PTP): Up to 20+ km (clear line-of-sight)

  • Point-to-Multipoint (as CPE): 8–15 km

Ideal For:

  • Rural wireless broadband delivery

  • ISP last-mile solutions

  • Wireless CCTV and IP camera backhaul

  • Building-to-building connectivity

  • Campus and industrial networking
